protocols.name: Messaging Layer Security 1.0
security_notes: Provides efficient asynchronous group key establishment with forward secrecy and post-compromise security.
E2EESA 0.1 permits MLS cipher suites 0x0001 and 0x0003 and requires exact pinning.
Application membership authorization remains an application policy and MUST be authenticated into accepted group state.

protocols.name: E2EESA Sender-Keys-style AEAD group profile
protocols.specification: E2EESA group profile based on the deployed Sender Keys architecture
security_notes: Each sender maintains a one-way symmetric chain and distributes sender state over authenticated pairwise E2EE sessions.
E2EESA uses registry-approved KDF, AEAD, and signature algorithms rather than claiming wire compatibility with a specific deployed Sender Keys implementation.
Membership changes require complete sender-key rotation and redistribution to the new current membership.
The profile claims forward secrecy from one-way chain advancement but does not claim automatic post-compromise security.

protocols.name: Pairwise ciphertext fanout
protocols.specification: E2EESA composition of pairwise E2EE sessions
security_notes: Each group message is independently encrypted to each current recipient device using the selected E2EESA pairwise profile.
No shared group content key exists.
Bandwidth and encryption work grow linearly with recipient devices.
